description: This file is a complete HTML document that implements a web-based database visualizer UI. It includes styling, structure, and embedded JavaScript for fetching and displaying database names, tables, and data with interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from server and populates sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database to show tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and injects HTML table from data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for table cell, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content on click.
